_comment: Tier-2 for skfem hyperelasticity#11, verified 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1. Claim: skfem.helpers.det/inv silently return all-zeros for any square matrix whose leading dimension is not 2 or 3, because helpers.py branches on A.shape[0]==2/==3 with no else and the seeded zeros_like stick; no NotImplementedError. Ran: det/inv on diagonal (d,d,4,3) fields for d = 2,3,4,5,6 under warnings.catch_warnings(record=True), an inspect.getsource check of helpers.det, and a log(det(F)) step on a 4x4 augmented deformation gradient. Printed: d=2 gives 4.0 and d=3 gives 8.0 (both analytic), while d=4,5,6 all give det exactly 0.0 against analytic 16/32/64 and inv all-zeros, with an EMPTY warning list at every d and no exception at all (silent_no_exception=True); the source contains both == 2 and == 3 branches, seeds zeros_like(A[0, 0]) and has no else; downstream, det(F4)=0 makes log(J) = -inf everywhere and the only warning that ever appears is numpy's own 'divide by zero encountered in log', never anything from skfem.
